citation.authors: Rigel DS, Taylor SC, Lim HW, Alexis AF et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.design: Modified Delphi consensus on photoprotection for all skin colours
record.finding: The panel states that visible light can induce hyperpigmentation in people with dark skin types (Fitzpatrick IV-VI) and exacerbate melasma. The specific product recommendations are in the full text, which I did not open.
